theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios cover fund management costs. Lower ratios mean more returns reach you. Compare ratios across similar fund categories.
caption: Every rupee invested should work efficiently. Expense ratios are annual charges that impact your long-term wealth creation. Know what you pay for professional management. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestSmartly #FundKnowledge #WealthCreation
